description: This file defines the PlatformCacheConfiguration class that configures caching for the Fineract project using Spring Framework annotations. It sets up a CacheManager bean delegated to a RuntimeDelegatingCacheManager.

classes.name: PlatformCacheConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class that sets up cache management with Spring caching annotations and provides a CacheManager bean delegated to RuntimeDelegatingCacheManager.

methods.name: cacheManager
methods.description: Provides the CacheManager bean, delegating to the injected RuntimeDelegatingCacheManager.
